label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.7 a.1… supports Whatever is its own subsistent being is…
note: Q.7 a.1 co. infers 'ipse Deus sit infinitus' from 'ipse sit suum esse subsistens', with esse as 'maxime formale omnium'. The claim states the general principle with a represented essence/esse equality as antecedent; the statement states it with the primitive own-being predicate. The passage applies it to God only.
